title: Asynchronous desktop lifecycle correctness
summary: Resolved stale-state and concurrency defects across project loading, DRC execution and desktop/backend integration.

dates.note: First inspected milestone: 2024-04-17. See facts for earlier/later feature stages; this is neither proof of first-ever work nor a formal role/leadership start or shipped release date.

facts.text: Resolved desktop failures involving corrupt configuration startup, inconsistent checkpoints, stale work across reloads, competing project loads and subscription/observer lifetimes.
Introduced unique DRC request IDs and rejected stale execution after reload so concurrent backend responses update the correct view, with unit and Playwright regressions.
Prevented superseded project loads from applying late state through per-load snapshots, revision/request identities, subscription cancellation and callback ownership checks.
Hardened DRC dialogs with separate module/result request sequences, response listeners attached before dispatch and corrected warning initialization.

notes: 2026-10-27 local Git/source research supplements prior evidence. Authorship supports attributable implementation; shared components and later colleague changes retain separate ownership. No employer tests were rerun.
